description:
Your service records, kept for as long as you own the car. On your phone, not on someone else's server.

Most car maintenance apps want an account, a login and a sync. One broken login and years of log book history are gone. Wrenchy works differently: no account, no server, nothing to sync. Every oil change, tyre rotation and repair you log stays on your phone.

WHAT IT DOES
- Log oil changes, tyre rotations, brakes, filters, coolant, spark plugs and anything else you type in, on any number of cars
- Know when the next one is due, by date or by kilometres, whichever comes first, with a reminder on the day
- See the full service history for each car at a glance
- Export the lot to CSV whenever you want. Export is free for everyone and never behind the subscription

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
No account. No login. No server. No sync to break. Your history cannot vanish, because there is nothing for it to vanish from. It sits on the phone, the same way the paper log book sits in the glovebox.

BUILT FOR THE WAY WE DRIVE HERE
- Kilometres, not miles. Due dates read off the odometer the way the log book is stamped
- Log book servicing on your car's own intervals, whether the book says 10,000 km, 15,000 km or twelve months
- Rego and the roadworthy sit in the same log as the servicing. What the safety check is called and how often it comes around is set by your state, or by the WoF cycle in New Zealand, so you set the date and Wrenchy reminds you
- Dark, glare-friendly screens, built to be read in the driveway or standing at the workshop counter

WHO IT'S FOR
Daily drivers, weekend mechanics, tradies keeping a ute on the road, and anyone who wants proof of service history when the car goes up for sale. A private buyer discounts what you cannot show them, and so does the dealer taking it as a trade-in. Keep every oil change, tyre and repair in one searchable log instead of a folder of receipts in the glovebox.

Free for one car. Wrenchy Pro adds unlimited cars and custom service intervals. Export always stays free, for everyone.

whatsNew:
Glovebox is now Wrenchy.

Same app, same private service log with no account and no server. Only the name has changed — every record you have entered is still on your phone, exactly where it was.
